recall.answer: Stretches the RoPE ruler 50x; needs long-document training.

recall.question: Why must train and serve templates match byte-exactly?
recall.answer: Train/serve mismatch reads as role confusion.

recall.question: What four items make a full checkpoint state?
recall.answer: Weights, optimizer moments, RNG state, data position.

What does the replay check show?

keyTerms.definition: 8.39M LoRA vs 1074M full; a new language needs full.
Cannot carry a new language: pick full or high-r.

recall.question: Give E1's answers.
recall.answer: (a) 8.39M. (b) 1074M. (c) Full (or high-r): a new language is a big shift, rank 16 cannot carry it.

recall.question: Is the 3x curation cost worth it?
recall.answer: Worth it when behavior quality is the product: the tradeoff is 7500 vs 750 bad lessons at 3x annotation cost.

keyTerms.definition: System tokens get mask 1; the model learns to emit system instructions.
The model learns to emit them: the consequence.

recall.question: What is the mask bug and the fix?
recall.answer: System tokens get mask 1, so the model learns to emit system instructions. Fix: mask 1 only for assistant.

keyTerms.definition: Isolate: the 100k doc wastes 50 bins and breaks packing.

recall.question: Pack or isolate the 100k-token document?
recall.answer: Isolate: a 100k document in 2048-bins wastes 50 bins of padding around it and breaks packing efficiency; give it dedicated batches or truncate to windows.

keyTerms.definition: Run it on v2+adapter before any use.

recall.question: State the verdict and check for v1 adapters on v2.
recall.answer: Incompatible until proven otherwise: the adapter's base changed. Run the eval suite on v2+adapter before any use.

keyTerms.definition: The training-set disclosure; the first gap.
The win may cost base ability: report base slices.

recall.question: Name the three gaps in the SFT paper and their disclosures.
recall.answer: (1) No data card: the training set is unknown, publish it. (2) No mask: the objective is unknown, describe it. (3) No regression check: the win may cost base ability, report base slices.
